features.description: Cargo scaffold + repo registry CLI (repo add/list/remove)
expectedBehavior: repo list prints repos with discovered active mission

features.description: Mission data model + lenient loaders in src/data/
expectedBehavior: MissionSnapshot::load parses state.json, features.json, progress_log.jsonl and handoffs/*.json into typed models
Missing or corrupt files yield empty defaults + collected warnings, never a panic
Realistic fixtures parse with correct field values

features.description: Derived views: MissionSummary + WorkerSession list in src/data/derive.rs
expectedBehavior: WorkerSession list includes still-running worker with live duration

features.description: Terminal lifecycle + app shell + main dashboard screen
expectedBehavior: Raw mode + alternate screen on entry; restored on exit and in panic hook
Selector screen lists registered repos with active mission state
Dashboard renders header, state badge, progress gauge, features list, progress log
